**Verdict: PASS** for DG2 round 8, candidate `sha256:9331e9d1…124f` (539 files, source `cf3446e4`). The candidate ID matched at the start and at the end of my run. HEAD moved during the run to other agents' commits, which I did not open.

## F-DG2-310 (Low, my round-7 finding): CLOSED_VERIFIED
- **Port defaults:** every disposable-cluster harness now starts below the range where the kernel assigns client ports (32768–60999). A sample of 3,000 client ports never went below 32770, so the original collision can't hit a default port.
- **`port-collision-check.sh`:** passes 5/5, and its control case still reproduces the old defect on the previous harness.
- **My own checks on the real stacks (with-stack, qa-stack, A18 clean start, clean-start-local):** I forced the collision on each stack's default PostgreSQL and API ports. Each stack retried, logged it, and published the ports it actually used. Two runs on the same port both started. A foreign listener was never taken over. Strict mode, non-port startup failures and exhausted retries all stop with BLOCKED (exit 3).
- **Every run this round started on its first attempt.**

## Regression, both locale settings (unset and `LANG=C.UTF-8`)
| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck, build, lint, openapi:lint, no-cdn, format, contrast | all exit 0 (contract: 161 operations) |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and 24 | 9/9 runs, 691/691, including one under CPU load |
| Integration (5 runs per locale) | 10/10 runs, 547/547, 0 skipped: 19 migrations, DB guards, contract (161 routed), blank-text, encoding, invalid-character, framework-errors, invalid-utf8 |
| Integration with my acceptance suites | 587/587 per locale |
| Product e2e (EN and AR) | 62/62 per locale, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 |
| My acceptance journey (`qa-stack.sh`) | 126/126 per locale, `server_encoding UTF8` in the log |
| Accessibility (axe) | 0 violations over 592 screens, plus my error-state checks |
| Validator `--register`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile` | PASS |

My new checks for the strict UTF-8 change:
- **Invalid UTF-8 bodies:** all 48 raw requests get 400 `validation.json`. They cover 8 invalid byte shapes, sent with Content-Length, as chunks and split across chunks, with and without a session. Nothing is stored.
- **`?q=%FF`-style queries:** all 104 probes across every GET query parameter get 400 `validation.format`. Without a session it is still 401.
- **Arabic and emoji text:** round-trips exactly, even when cut mid-character across chunks, and through the UI in English and Arabic.
- **429:** all 161 operations declare it.

## Findings
- **F-DG2-340, Low, not mandatory, owner frontend-ux-engineer.** The charter form (shared RecordForm component) shows the new invalid-request message twice, in two alert boxes, in both English and Arabic. A screen reader would announce it twice. The cause is older logic from round 4 that the strict UTF-8 change exposed. The normal app can't trigger it; only a tampered request does.

## Run notes
Two runs of my acceptance journey failed because of my own mistakes. Neither involved the product, and both are logged and explained:
- I left older test copies inside the disposable clone.
- My new spec read a response body before it arrived.

I fixed the spec and reran both locales green. An attempt to stop the first batch didn't reach it, so I kept its partial log, labelled it as not counted, and corrected my first note on it.

Live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049) are recorded as passing on their offline or configuration checks, with the remaining live gap noted. I grant no business approval, and product gates G1–G6 never imply DG7.

## Files
Records are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-8/`; both JSON records pass the project's schema check:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-8/`. My new spec is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-8/e2e/dg2-qa-r8.spec.ts`. The disposable clone has been removed.
